content_sections.heading: About IICA
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs, Manesar is an autonomous institution registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India. According to the circular, it works as a Government think tank on corporate laws, policies, governance and regulation, and trains Group 'A' Government Officers and board members through its five Schools and eleven Centres. Its campus is at Plot No.6, 7 & 8, Sector-5, IMT Manesar, District-Gurugram, PIN-121 052 (Haryana).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The applicant must be an Indian Citizen. Eligibility, educational qualifications, experience and age are counted as on the last date for submission of applications, 17 December 2026. B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Electronics/Electronics & Telecommunications/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation/Information Technology from UGC & AICTE recognized university/institute; OR Bachelor in Computer Applications & Masters in Computer Applications from UGC & AICTE recognized university/institute; OR Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Electronics/Electronics & Telecommunications/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation/Information Technology from UGC & AICTE recognized university/institute. The notice adds that if a class/division is not awarded, a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate is considered equivalent to 1st class/division, and a CGPA will be converted to equivalent marks. Minimum 5 years of relevant, proven hands-on and validated experience in designing, developing, coding, testing, deploying, maintaining and debugging tier-based web applications/software systems (frontend & backend). The same range of experience on tier-based, dynamic and media-rich interactive websites/web portals (front end & backend), including hosting. Having worked on the full end-to-end spectrum of popular application stacks. Out of the 5 years, minimum 3 years in .NET and experience of Dot Net Application development. Requisite experience: 3+ years developing dot net application and 2+ years with coding and deployment of Web API Services. Mandatory: ASP.NET – 1 year; MVC – 1 year. Preferred: AWS – 1 year. A strong understanding of industry trends and content management systems; experience with responsive and adaptive design is strongly preferred; understanding of the entire web development process (design, development, deployment) is preferred. Preferred skills: SEO (on page), SMO; PHP back-end development and MySQL; a framework (Code igniter/Laravel/CakePhp/Zend/Symfony/Yii) or CMS (WordPress/Magento/Drupal/Joomla); JavaScript, JQuery, Word Press, CSS, Magento. Generic skills: documenting operational processes, good written and verbal communication, problem solving and analytical skills, attention to detail, and being a team player. C#, ASP.Net, MVC, LINQ, jQuery, WCF, API & SQL Server; expert-level C#, MVC, WPF, Data Structure and Design Patterns. Entity Framework or another ORM; advanced SQL, LINQ and JavaScript; React JS/Angular; HTML, CSS, Bootstrap. TFS/GIT, Docker, Azure/AWS Cloud, MSSQL, JSON, SSIS, SSRS, and iPaaS system integration (via Jitter Bit) between on-premises and cloud processes. Strong WCF, including SOAP and REST bindings, securing services and encrypting the communication channel; SOA experience. Responsive user interfaces, debugging tools (Firebug, Chrome inspector), RESTful APIs (JSON, XML), Git, SVN and Mercurial, and Object-Oriented Programming and technical architec

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be paid Rs. 75,000/- per month as consolidated pay. No other allowances or benefits such as Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Leave Travel Concession (LTC), medical facilities or other compensation packages will be admissible. Leave will be granted as per the policy of the Institute. The engagement is on a purely contractual basis and is extendable based on performance and the requirement of the Institute. The duty schedule is six (06) days a week with 1 weekly off (as decided by the controlling officer), from 09:30 AM to 6:00 with a 30-minute lunch break.

content_sections.heading: IICA Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The circular describes the job brief as follows: Design, develop, program, test, deploy and take live stable releases of bespoke applications/software systems (frontend & backend) to achieve end-to-end automation and digitization of the organisation's processes. Manage, maintain, update, redesign and debug the official website and all associated micro sites, including development, hosting and cloud environments, databases and payment gateways. Design, develop and implement Web APIs and enterprise-level applications. Handle both back-end and front-end development, including themes and plug-ins, using PHP, HTML5, CSS3, MySQL and JavaScript along with design aesthetics. The key responsibilities listed in the notice include: Designing and implementing new features for the organisation's website, micro sites and applications, and establishing and guiding the website's architecture. Ensuring high performance and availability, and managing all technical aspects of the CMS, templates, themes and plug-ins. Developing all server-side logic and maintaining the central database. Managing application development work streams, working with the IT management team, peers, external suppliers and Solution Architects. Development and coding of complex .Net, WCF and SQL based solutions; code review and quality checks of other team members' work; defining coding and automated unit testing guidelines. Diagnosing and troubleshooting deployment/production issues. Building responsive, mobile-friendly, accessible and secure websites with clean, well-documented code in HTML, CSS, XML and JavaScript. Maintaining and updating existing websites ( www.iica.nic.in ) and micro sites, and testing new and current websites to correct errors.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All applications received by the due date will be screened against the minimum educational qualifications and experience. The Institute reserves the right to devise its own shortlisting criteria, and the duly constituted Selection Committee will shortlist candidates. Meeting the minimum qualifications does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a presentation and/or interview before the Selection Committee, held at IICA Campus, Manesar or through video conference, on a date and time to be communicated separately. The institute will communicate only with shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IICA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) post of Sr. Web & Application Developer in the IT Division.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IICA Sr. Web & Application Developer post?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of applications is 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics or a related listed discipline, or BCA & MCA, or a Post Graduate Degree in those disciplines from a UGC & AICTE recognized university/institute, with minimum 5 years of relevant experience including 3 years in .NET.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The candidate must be below 63 years as on the closing date, 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IICA Sr. Web & Application Developer?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 75,000/- per month as consolidated pay.

faq.question: Q6. Are HRA or other allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that DA, Transport Allowance, HRA, LTC, medical facilities and other compensation packages are not admissible.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit your CV and certificates through the Google Form link given in the notice (https://forms.gle/tKP8x4d4L6xCwtdY8) by 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are screened and shortlisted by the Selection Committee, and shortlisted candidates are called for a presentation and/or interview at IICA Campus, Manesar or through video conference.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is on a purely contractual basis, extendable based on performance and the requirement of the Institute.

faq.question: Q10. Which certifications are mandatory?
faq.answer: ASP.NET (1 year) and MVC (1 year) are mandatory; AWS (1 year) is preferred.
